name: codex-shunt
description: Route high-volume, predictable Codex work to a subscription-authenticated Luna worker and measure the result.

interface.shortDescription: Route bulk work to Luna and measure usage.
interface.longDescription: Codex Shunt keeps judgment-heavy work in the primary model while routing explicitly acknowledged large reads and predictable analysis to a subscription-authenticated GPT-6 Luna worker. Guided setup verifies authentication and the worker path; local content-free telemetry produces CLI, JSON, CSV, and HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Shunt and test its subscription worker.
Use Codex Shunt to inspect this repository.
Show my Codex Shunt usage statistics.
Summarize this large test log with Codex Shunt.
